plugin.name: Dialog Tune
plugin.description: Dialog Tune applies a targeted edit to an AI reply or to your own draft. Tap the Tune button under a message, or use the input box '+' menu and the action bar of the last message: describe the edit, optionally attach long-term memory and the last few messages as background, and the model API bound to the current chat regenerates the whole passage. The result shows only the rewritten text with the differences highlighted inline; nothing is written back until you confirm, and the result is stored as one more version of that message, so you can switch back to the original with Tavo's native version switching. The plugin makes no judgement calls for you: how much to change, what to keep, and whether to replace or append are all yours.
settings.info: Defaults for Dialog Tune. The guiding prompt tells the model how to carry out an edit — rewrite it to match your own writing habits.
settings.showInlineButton.desc: Shows a small Tune button under every message — the most direct way into a message.
settings.defaultUseMemory.desc: Attach the current chat's long-term memory when the panel opens. Your change is remembered for next time.
settings.defaultRecentN.desc: How many messages to attach when the panel opens (taken from before the tuned message). Your change is remembered.
settings.maxRecentN.desc: The highest number you can type in the panel.
settings.guidePrompt.default:
You are a text-editing assistant. Rewrite the passage below according to the player's edit request, and obey:
1. Change only the parts directly related to the request; keep everything else verbatim, including punctuation, line breaks, formatting, forms of address, proper nouns and emotional intensity.
2. Do not add or remove information, do not summarise, do not continue the text, do not comment on it.
3. Keep the original point of view, tense and tone; unless the request says so, do not turn narration into dialogue.
4. Output the complete rewritten passage, with no explanation, preamble, summary or Markdown code fences.
settings.guidePrompt.placeholder: Leave empty to use the default guiding prompt.
settings.guidePrompt.desc: This prompt is placed before the passage and tells the model how to carry out the edit. Edit it to suit your own habits.
settings.autoApply.desc: Skip the before/after view and write back as soon as the result is ready. Off by default.
settings.contentLanguage.desc: Decides which language the rewritten text uses. Defaults to the language of the source.
runtime.title: Dialog Tune
runtime.applied: Applied as one more version of this message — switch back to the original from the message versions
runtime.appliedPlain: Message overwritten (this floor keeps no versions, so the original cannot be restored)
runtime.appliedToInput: Put back in the input box
runtime.reverted: Switched back to the previous version
runtime.panelUnavailable: The Tune panel is not enabled — turn on the Chat page display position in the plugin settings
runtime.field.instructionPlaceholder: e.g. make the tone a bit more natural, keep everything else
runtime.switch.memoryHint: Adds the chat's long-term memory as background
runtime.switch.recentHint: Adds the messages before the tuned one as background
runtime.privacy: Enabled options are sent to the model together with the passage.
prompt.memoryBlock:
Below is the chat's long-term memory. It is background only — do not change the passage because of it:
<memory>
{memory}
</memory>
prompt.recentBlock:
Below are the recent messages. They are background only — do not change the passage because of them:
<dialogue>
{dialogue}
</dialogue>
prompt.outputLanguageSource: Write the output in the same language as the source.
prompt.outputRule: Now output the complete rewritten passage, with no explanation, preamble or code fences.
error.messageMissing: Message not found, it may have been deleted
error.emptyResult: The model returned nothing, please try again
error.copyFailed: Copy failed, please select the text and copy manually
error.applyFailed: Could not apply, the original was left untouched
error.noVariants: There is no other version to switch to
error.targetChanged: The target changed, this result was discarded
runtime.thinking.label: Thinking mode
runtime.thinking.hint: Applies to this tuning request only — your own API settings stay untouched. Parameter ids look like openai.reasoning_effort, claude_thinking.budget_tokens, gemini_thinking_level
runtime.thinking.level.label: Level
runtime.thinking.custom.label: 手动 HTTP body
settings.thinkingCustomBody.desc: Used when the panel selects "Custom JSON". The content is sent as extra request fields with the tuning request.
error.thinkingParamRejected: The model rejected the thinking parameters ({detail}). Try a different "Where to place the parameters" setting, or turn thinking off.
releaseNotes.1_1_1:
## 1.1.1

- Thinking parameters now use Tavo's internal model parameter ids (e.g. openai.reasoning_effort); the native layer translates them per platform
- Removed the 'where to place the parameters' setting: text generation has no extraBody, the old form was wrong
- The manual JSON example now shows the parameter id form
